issue: sim ring — second bind group for indexable simulation state (Physics Lab set 2)
description: Opt-in @group(1) simulation ring. Group 0 stays the unchanged 14-entry catalog contract (src/contracts/webgpu_limits.json). A shader that declares @group(1) is compiled against a two-group pipeline layout [group0, group1]; every other shader keeps today's single-layout pipeline and never pays for group 1. The ring buffers are allocated lazily, the first time a group-1 shader compiles. Enforced by `npm run verify:device-policy` (scripts/verify-device-policy-sync.js verifyBindGroup1).

bindings.name: simState
bindings.role: Live particles / photons / walkers. Shaders read and write it freely; GraphRunner nodes declare it in bufferWrites.

bindings.name: simIndex
bindings.role: Read-only snapshot: neighbour indices, spatial hash, or the previous iteration of simState. Shaders cannot write it; the host fills it with a copyBufferToBuffer(simState -> simIndex) barrier, the buffer mirror of the dataA -> dataC texture handoff.

bindings.name: simParams
bindings.role: stateCount = live simState elements (after the OOM ladder), indexCount = simIndex elements, frame = frames since the ring was allocated, truncated = 1 when the ladder shrank the ring.

barrier.bytes: min(simState.size, simIndex.size) — both default to 1 MiB, so the whole ring is published
barrier.when: Before a node that lists simIndex in bufferReads, if simState was written since the last publish (including between repeats of the same node); and once after the graph if simState was written and any node reads simIndex, so the next frame starts from a published snapshot.

values.pixels: default — ceil(scaledW / wg.x) × ceil(scaledH / wg.y), same as every other graph node
values.simState: ceil(stateCount / wg.x) × 1 — one invocation per live particle; use @workgroup_size(64, 1, 1)

limitsRationale.maxStorageBuffersPerShaderStage: group 0 uses 2 (extraBuffer, plasmaBuffer) + group 1 uses 2 (simState, simIndex). WebGPU base limit is 8.
limitsRationale.maxUniformBuffersPerShaderStage: group 0 uses 1 (u) + group 1 uses 1 (simParams). WebGPU base limit is 12.
limitsRationale.maxBindGroups: group 0 + group 1. WebGPU base limit is 4.

oomLadder.rule: Allocate simState + simIndex together under an out-of-memory error scope. On OOM destroy both, latch the next rung in sessionStorage and never retry a larger rung in this tab (same discipline as px_history_oom_cap).
oomLadder.pascalNote: Default cap is 65536 × 16 B simState (1 MiB) + 262144 × 4 B simIndex (1 MiB) + 16 B params ≈ 2 MiB — under 2% of the 2048²×8 history ring that OOMs Pascal, so the ring is not the rung that tips a GTX 10-series over.

wasm.rule: C++ is feature-frozen until #1080. pipeline.cpp keeps bindGroupLayoutCount = 1 (group 1 unbound -> nullptr layout[1]). The WASM bridge refuses group-1 shaders before they reach LoadShader, so the module never sees an invalid pipeline and never aborts.
